info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Proofs-v3-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipment Proofs API enables users to access and retrieve detailed information about proofs associated with logistics shipments. This endpoint is designed for logistics managers and supply chain professionals who need to validate proof of delivery and other related documentation. Through this API, consumers can efficiently manage and verify shipment records, supporting operational transparency and accuracy in delivery processes. The API streamlines the retrieval of vital shipment proofs, enhancing visibility across the supply chain.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve proof information related to shipments, including any relevant documents or confirmation details documented during the shipping process.

requestBody.description: The request payload for retrieving shipment proof. This should contain the necessary information to identify the shipment for which proof is being requested.

200.description: Successful retrieval of shipment proof data.
